title: Email proof panel
responsibility: Collects the emailed verification code needed to finish sign-in.

inputs.name: EmailProofPanel.proof
inputs.description: Required email-proof status with target email, sent flag and optional expiry. Input is disabled until sent; the sent flag also chooses Send or Resend wording.

outputs.name: EmailProofPanel
outputs.description: Email confirmation form with send/resend, numeric code entry, Verify and Cancel. Verify requires exactly the configured number of digits and a nonbusy session, and clears code on reported success. Cancel clears code then signs out. Session errors are shown; successful verification does not itself assume a signed-in actor.
